controls.coherent_Root_method: Independently reconstructed all10 bytes from installed117 preimages, three accepted component deltas and two guidance insertions with standard patch --fuzz=0; compiled10/10.
controls.cross_consumer: Distinct-key CSV facts -> native PPTX creation -> reader -> selected merge choosing second title -> preserving authored chart edit; exact source payload retention and negative controls.

data_behavior: Exact-header typed XLSX or strict UTF8 comma CSV; row counts separate from distinct exact text keys.
Exact supported decimal values and aggregates, source provenance and generated factual prose; selected formula cells refuse; ignored caches do not supply facts.
Bounded frames and explicit text/font/row limits; unsupported or oversized contents refuse.
installed_baseline: Source117 unchanged; no native generation, installation or runtime effects from this publication.
limits: Authored creation now refuses formerly accepted oversized tables/charts or text.
pptx_edit changes selected title/chart/workbook only; it does not recompute source-bound table, conclusion, totals or basis. Generic source-bound edit semantics remain UNACCEPTED.
Regenerate source-bound creation to update all factual slides.
Template/slideshow read support does not grant creation/edit/conversion authority.
patch_scope: Complete 10 native leaves: source-bound typed spreadsheet/CSV creation and conservative layout limits, native template/slideshow reading, selected native PPTX merge; includes prior published reader and merge components.

scope_preserved.native_variants: All required variants remain separate obligations.

source_custody: Descriptor ownership, source CAS, cancellation, NOREPLACE and existing output protections retained; after-publication mutation/cancellation UNKNOWN retains saved output without replay.
